Backend 21/21 new tests (test_iteration12.py) + 38/38 regression (backend_test.py) = 59/59 green. Frontend verified for owner/finance/sales/production roles: home=/ is Unified Inbox with capture (owner only), filter chips with counts, mark-done/dismiss, pending approvals with approve/reject, 360° ContactProfile with 4 stat cards + all sections, role-gated view-profile (owner+finance only), production/sales get 'Restricted' page on direct /contacts/:id navigation. Nav reorder correct: Inbox first pointing to /, Daily Brief at /dashboard, Data Input present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1972 lines — growth continues past the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting: routers/inbox.py (~90 lines), routers/contacts_profile.py (~55 lines), routers/ingest.py (already flagged). Non-blocking.

contact_profile aggregation matches invoices/payments by BOTH contact_id OR case-insensitive exact contact_name — that's why 'Kumar Garments' inflated outstanding from earlier iterations still shows up (multiple filed rows). Fine for demo but eventually contact_id-only matching would be more precise.

contact_profile tasks are matched by loose regex on task.title (case-insensitive substring of contact name). Prone to false positives if contact name is a common word ('Sharma', 'Kumar'). Would be safer to link tasks via a contact_id field. Non-blocking.

contact_profile 'price_history' iterates purchase invoice line_items — only populated if line_items were extracted by the AI during ingestion. For customer contacts price_history is always empty (by design). Consider hiding the section in the UI when empty.

Inbox capture UI is correctly gated by user.role==='owner' (line 145 of Inbox.js). 'Upload data' button uses canUpload=[owner,sales,finance]. This is intentional and matches spec — non-owners see owner-only-notice but sales/finance can still click Upload Data → /ingest (consistent with INGEST_ROLES). Good.

Ask AI money-restriction message relies entirely on the LLM to refuse for sales/production. Backend does NOT strip financial context — it just tells the model to say 'restricted'. In practice tests passed (model refuses), but a determined prompt-injection could get around it. Consider stripping numeric amounts from context entirely for non-money roles. Low priority.
GET /api/inbox returns up to 300 rows unbounded — no pagination. With WhatsApp firehose enabled later this needs limit/offset.
GET /api/contacts/{id}/profile does not enforce that the contact belongs to the same tenant explicitly at the response level (it uses tenant_id in the query — safe). Just noting for clarity.

Mobile bottom nav data-testid for '/' is still `bottomnav-dashboard` (Layout.js line 240). Now that '/' is Inbox this label is stale — consider renaming to `bottomnav-inbox` for consistency. Cosmetic.

openItem() in Inbox.js only routes ingestion and complaint items ('View' button). Invoice/payment inbox items currently show View but navigate nowhere useful (they render as classification=invoice/payment but ref_type is 'invoice'/'payment' — no click handler). Not a bug per spec but a small UX gap.
